question: Which of the following is an example of an input device that allows users to interact with a computer by typing text?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Keyboard**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A **keyboard** is a primary input device used to interact with a computer by typing text, numbers, and executing commands.
 
• Keyboards are designed with **alphanumeric keys** (letters and numbers), function keys, navigation keys, and special characters.
 
• Modern keyboards include additional features such as shortcut keys for multimedia control and programmable keys for custom tasks.
 
• Keyboards can be **wired** (using USB or PS/2 connections) or **wireless** (using Bluetooth or RF technology).
 
• Various types of keyboards include **standard QWERTY keyboards**, ergonomic keyboards, and compact keyboards, catering to different user needs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Input Devices:**

 
 
• Input devices are hardware components used to send data or instructions to a computer system.
 
• Examples include **keyboard, mouse, scanner, joystick, microphone, and webcam.**
 
• These devices allow users to interact with and control computer systems efficiently.
 
 
 
• **Output Devices:**
 
 
• These devices receive data from a computer and convert it into a human-readable form, such as visuals or sound.
 
• Examples include **monitors, printers, speakers, and projectors.**
 
 
 
• **Human-Computer Interaction (HCI):**
 
 
• HCI refers to the study of how users interact with computer systems and devices.
 
• Keyboards play a vital role in HCI, allowing users to input commands and data seamlessly.
 
 
 
• **Ergonomics of Keyboards:**
 
 
• Ergonomic keyboards are designed to reduce strain on hands and wrists during prolonged usage.
 
• These keyboards help prevent repetitive strain injuries, such as carpal tunnel syndrome.
